hypothesis: The first predicted fixed-pair geometric deviation, when fed into call 1, affects subsequent predictions and may influence terminal fixed-fragment preservation.
primary_observation: Mean relative-vector error in Angstrom over calls 1-4, relative to the fixed input; paired against the same-seed sham.
secondary_observations: Expected-bond probability over calls 1-4, complete raw network trajectory, and separate terminal chemistry, fixed-fragment, geometry, and scaffold-change endpoints.
scope: One-complex exploratory causal test. Not a unique-root-cause claim or independent generalization test. No outcome-driven changes to call, magnitude, pair, or control count.
